title: gp.v1.Playbook
description: Canonical proto3 JSON for the Pharmakos playbook vocabulary, generated from the checked-in descriptor set. Property names are the .proto spelling, which is what the canonical form writes and what a player hand-edits; a reader also accepts the lowerCamelCase alternates the proto3 JSON mapping defines. An unknown field is rejected and never stripped.
